description: I love visualizing, building machines, and imagining life and exploration beyond Earth. I’m excited to tell the stories of NASA’s forgotten space equipment and team up with people interested in 3D design, coding, animation, storytelling, and space science.
summary: This presentation discusses the objects left on the Moon and Mars by space missions over time. It begins with a summary of the types of missions, with examples of different spacecraft. We then explore the different categories of objects and equipment. Finally, we ask what the implications are of these pieces to future missions and to the environment overall. We conclude with some solutions.
details: This presentation tells the story of select missions to the Moon and Mars and the outcomes of the pieces and equipment left behind. It asks us to weigh the gains made in human achievement against the costs to the environment. Data comprises mission information taken from NASA web sites along with other sources. It is framed as a presentation given to a Grade 8 science class.
